attackers_goals: Adversaries use this to ensure that they possess the corresponding private key and may log in as an existing user via SSH.
description: A process modified an SSH authorized_keys file, which is used in SSH authentication. An attack can add or remove an SSH key to gain access to a targeted host.
detector_tags: Kubernetes - AGENT, Containers, Generic Persistence Analytics
investigative_actions: Check the file modification, try to understand the impact of the related processes and network connections.
